messages:
Ellie: Heads-up — prototyping a 'soft-redirect' autofallback UX that routes a % of requests to a cheaper/safer variant but keeps a forensic trace for audit. want quick feedback before design sync.

Chris: Love the name :grin: what are the signals to trigger? spikes? error classes?

Ellie: Main triggers: 5xx rate, latency p95 > 1.5x baseline, routing-level quota exhaustion. also a 'quality_regression' signal from evals (optional).

Samir: Quota exhaustion is tricky — should soft-redirect bypass per-customer rate limiter? we need per-tenant audit if so.

Noelle: Agree. Also need a clear visual in Console showing which sessions were redirected and why, otherwise SRE/support will be lost.

Ellie: Right. Thinking a breadcrumb in the request trace + a `fallback_reason` tag. quick policy snippet: 
```json
{"trigger": "latency_p95", "threshold_ms": 1200, "mode": "soft_redirect", "sample_rate": 0.2}
```

Chris: Looks fine. How do we avoid oscillation? if p95 hovers around threshold we might flip back and forth.

Samir: Add hysteresis window + min-duration. eg require condition for 2 consecutive minutes or 5k requests, then route. also a cool-down of 3m before switching back.

Ellie: UX question: expose hysteresis knobs to operators or pick sane defaults and hide advanced? i lean defaults + per-project overrides.

Noelle: Expose them but collapsed under "advanced" with a tooltip. also add a 'preview' toggle that simulates X% of traffic without changing live routing.

Chris: Telemetry needs: counts of redirected requests per model+route, latency histograms, and a diff on output-quality metric (embedding-sim / task metric).

Samir: Also record small 'audit snapshots' of redirected requests (PII-redacted) for offline QA and regression analysis.

deployment-bot: note: can enable soft-redirect in staging automatically when rollout tag=preview.

Ellie: @Samir on per-tenant quotas — if we let soft-redirect bypass limits we should add a `delegated_quota` flag and surface it in billing logs.

Samir: yep. add `delegated_quota: true/false` to policy. billing asked for `redirected_token_count` metric.

Noelle: One more: make audit trail immutable — create an event id per decision with references to policy version + routing snapshot.

Chris: Question: how heavy will sampling be? if sample_rate=0.2 for large customers that's a lot of storage.

Ellie: we'll cap stored snapshots per route per hour. default 100/hr, configurable. also TTL for snapshots (30d) before purge.

Noelle: :thumbsup: i'll mock Console breadcrumbs, policy editor advanced section, and an exportable audit CSV.

Samir: Implementation notes: runtime must evaluate policy cheap — do pre-routing filter and use sticky routing for session continuity. avoid per-request model lookups.

Ellie: thanks all — i'll open a PR with the policy schema + a small Console playground. PTAL when i link it.
